podcast.body: The second album from PortiGer escalated the level of scratching experimentation, featuring astonishing moments in songs such as "Cowboys," "Elisium," and "Onlea U," which left listeners questioning how such sounds were produced with a turntable. "al día segundo disco de PortiGer que tenía esos momentos Scratchin tan increíbles como puede ser en el Cowboys o como puede ser en el Elisium o en el Onlea U que era como ya un nuevo nivel."

This debut album by PortiGer features incredible and unprecedented scratching moments, exemplified in tracks like "Doom" and "Wondering Star." At the time, many believed Yeop Barrow's scratching involved complex post-production due to its seemingly impossible nature. "recordamos el primer disco de PortiGer que nos deja momentos increíbles de un Scratchin completamente jamás visto como puede ser en la canción de Doom o como puede ser en la canción de Wondering Star."
